verdict.rationale: Bitwarden's integrated authenticator documents automatic TOTP generation (six-digit SHA-1 codes rotating every 30 seconds), which covers the code-generation half of the story. No evidence shows scanning a new account's setup QR code; the only QR reference is migrating codes in from Google Authenticator, which is an import feature and is not credited here. One community report of TOTP not working is too vague to dispute the documented capability. Missing for 10: documented QR-code scanning to enroll a new account, the scan-to-immediate-code flow, and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an everyday user, I can scan a QR code and immediately start generating TOTP codes for a new account
